summary: Seat admission also counts interactive seats. On hosts with interactive sessions, starts may wait for room where they were admitted before.

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persisted data changes.

rules.detail: Seat admission also counts interactive seats. A measured saturated host accounts for about 23.6 GB more memory. Managed starts can wait indefinitely until interactive usage falls, workloads move, or the operator uses the existing --ignore-fit override with --reason on fractal agents restart.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional downtime required.

manual.detail: On saturated hosts, reduce interactive usage or move workloads to make room for managed starts. If an operator deliberately bypasses fit, use fractal agents restart with --ignore-fit --reason <reason>; the actor and reason are recorded. This override does not free memory.

recovery.detail: No data migration is needed to revert the binary.
